frontmatter.title: Data Visualization: An Introduction to D3.js
frontmatter.subheading: A JavaScript library that is widely used for creating data visualizations on the web
frontmatter.excerpt: D3.js is a JavaScript library that is widely used for creating data visualizations on the web. D3 stands for Data-Driven Documents, which is an accurate description of what the library does. D3.js is a powerful tool for creating interactive and dynamic visualizations that can help you present complex data in a clear and easy-to-understand way.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
